extracted.intended_audience: Central Intelligence Group (CIG) communications, distribution, courier staff and participating departments' cable services
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative procedure for procurement, pickup, processing, security, distribution, receipting, and accounting of departmental cables furnished to the Central Intelligence Group (CIG). Covers responsibilities of Communications Division, ORB, Cable Control Unit, Distribution/Dissemination Branch, and participating departments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Objectives and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: The objectives are to establish a uniform system for the procurement, delivery, security and accounting of departmental cables furnished to CIG, to reduce administration incident to processing, and to expedite the flow of cables to those who require them in the performance of their duty.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to departmental cables furnished to CIG; the order defines the system and aims to minimize administrative burden while ensuring timely distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trial implementation and change control
rubrics_metrics.description: The particulars of this order will be put into effect on a trial basis at 0800, 17 December 1946. Initially, copies of cables will be procured and handled in quantities as indicated; action to effect necessary changes will be initiated by OCD as required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedure is initially trial; OCD (Office of Collection & Dissemination) will initiate changes based on experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Which cables to procure
rubrics_metrics.description: All incoming and outgoing cables containing intelligence information or relating to intelligence operations of interest to CIG will be procured; these include cables sent or received in response to specific CIG collection requests. All administrative cables pertaining to CIG operations will be similarly obtained.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procurement covers both substance (intelligence-related) and relevant administrative cables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participating departments' furnishing obligation
rubrics_metrics.description: Participating departments operating a cable service for procurement of intelligence information or for expediting administration in areas of CIG interest are required, under NIA Directives Nos. 1 and 5, to furnish the CIG with the cables described.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participating departments (State, War, Navy, etc.) are mandated to supply the cables to CIG per NIA directives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of copies and separation into sets
rubrics_metrics.description: CIG will, except as noted by exceptions, procure three (3) copies of cables described: separated into two (2) sets — set #1 containing two copies of each cable, and set #2 containing one copy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exceptions for particular departments or cable types are noted elsewhere; default is 3 copies divided into 2/1.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pickup locations (department-specific)
rubrics_metrics.description: Designated pickup points are specified for departments: e.g., State — Office of the Secretary of State (Room 108, State Department); War — Cable Branch, Office of the Director of Intelligence, WDGS, Room 2D841, Pentagon; Navy — Despatch Section, ONI (OP-32-C-241), Room 3722, Navy Department Building, and Top Secret Control (OP-32-Y-25), Room 3505A, Navy Department Building.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CIG Communications Division, P & A Branch will pick up at the specified departmental locations; some entries note special copying/delivery exceptions per department.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pickup frequency and schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: On days other than Saturday and Sunday, cables from each department will be picked up at least three (3) times a day per schedules published by Communications Division, P & A Branch; the Saturday schedule will consist of only one (1) pickup; unless otherwise directed no pickups on Sundays or legal holidays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Schedules will be published from time to time; adhere to weekday/ Saturday/holiday rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications Division responsibility for pickups and delivery
rubrics_metrics.description: Communications Division, P & A Branch is responsible for effecting pickups at the respective Departments and delivery to the proper CIG agency of all cables covered by this order.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authorized couriers will receipt for the cables as required, properly safeguard them, and deliver as specified in the order.

rubrics_metrics.name: Receipting and documentation (itemized receipt in duplicate)
rubrics_metrics.description: The two sets of cables (regardless of classification or source) will each be accompanied by an itemized receipt in duplicate for the cables contained in a set.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemized receipts must travel with each set; signed receipt copies provide accountability for delivery and retention by Communications Division and recipient (e.g., ORB).

rubrics_metrics.name: Delivery routing and receipt handling for sets
rubrics_metrics.description: CIG couriers will, without delay, deliver sets #1 directly to ORB (Room 115, Central Building) and receive from ORB a signed copy of the itemized receipt (retained by Communications Division and ORB). Couriers will next deliver sets #2 to the Cable Control Unit, Signal Center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strict routing: set #1 -> ORB; set #2 -> Cable Control Unit (exceptions noted for particular departmental cables). Maintain signed receipt copies as records.

rubrics_metrics.name: ORB screening and forwarding to Director of Central Intelligence
rubrics_metrics.description: ORB is responsible for screening all sets #1 cables and immediately extracting one copy of intelligence information cables which should be brought to the attention of the Director of Central Intelligence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cables selected for the Director are placed in suitable folders and delivered as soon as possible to the Secretary to the Director of Central Intelligence for circulation in the Director's office and return to ORB.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cable Control Unit separation and Distribution Division access
rubrics_metrics.description: The Cable Control Unit, Signal Center will separate the cables in set #2 into two groups: those containing intelligence information and administrative cables pertaining to CIG operations. The intelligence-information group will be made immediately available to authorized representatives of the Distribution Division, Dissemination Branch, OCD, for their examination (without receipt).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cable Control Unit will paraphrase and reproduce as required and distribute to appropriate operating offices as directed by the Distribution Division; special-case: in set #2 of War Department cables one copy of all intelligence cables will be delivered immediately to OSO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative cable processing and circulation
rubrics_metrics.description: The Cable Control Unit will determine and send to action and information addressees within CIG copies of administrative cables pertaining to CIG operations, reproducing and paraphrasing cables as required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A copy of important administrative cables will be sent to the Director of Central Intelligence for his information by the Cable Control Unit in the same manner as ORB does for intelligence cables.

rubrics_metrics.name: File retention and distribution accounting
rubrics_metrics.description: Communications Division, P & A Branch will retain for file a copy of all cables in set #2 and ensure that data pertaining to the number of copies reproduced and their distribution, both for action and for information within CIG, is clearly indicated for each cable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain clear records of reproduction counts and distribution destinations for audit/tracking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Off-duty priority cable notification and standby officer action
rubrics_metrics.description: If unusually important priority cables are received by a participating department during off-duty hours, the participating department will notify the standby officer of the Central Intelligence Group by calling Executive 6115. The CIG standby officer will then take necessary action as prescribed in CIG Administrative Memorandum dated 15 November 1946.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the prescribed off-hours notification channel (Executive 6115) and follow the referenced memorandum's procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency responsibility, accountability and security control
rubrics_metrics.description: (a) CIG agencies are responsible for all cables delivered to them. (b) All cables delivered to the Cable Control Unit, Signal Center will be the responsibility of that Unit; if and when distribution is accomplished as a result of distribution directives, the Cable Control Unit will establish necessary accounting and security control procedures. (c) Communications Division, P & A Branch will be the accountable CIG agency for only those cables received in CIG in accordance with the provisions of this order.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assign clear ownership of physical custody and accountability; establish accounting and security controls when redistributing cables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification marking on inter-office routing slip
rubrics_metrics.description: Routing slips include classification headers 'TOP SECRET SECRET CONFIDENTIAL/RESTRICTED UNCLASSIFIED' with instruction: '(Sender will circle classification Top and Bottom)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Senders must mark/circle the appropriate classification on routing slips top and bottom to ensure correct handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inter-office routing-slip routing/actions fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Routing slips list recipients (Director of Central Intelligence; Executive to the Director; Secretary to the Director; Executive Office; Advisory Council; Assistant Directors and branch chiefs) and action types (APPROVAL, ACTION, RECOMMENDATION, SIGNATURE, INFORMATION, RETURN, PREPARATION OF REPLY, CONCURRENCE, DIRECT REPLY, COMMENT, DISPATCH).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Routing slips must indicate intended addressee(s), initials, date, and the required action(s) to be taken for office routing and processing.
